package gooo_workspace
namespace gooo_workspace

entity Origin id "gooo://origin-reader/elements" fields {
    field case_index id "gooo://origin-reader/elements/case_index" type integer required one
    field instance_index id "gooo://origin-reader/elements/instance_index" type integer required one
    field element_index id "gooo://origin-reader/elements/element_index" type integer required one
    field root_activity_id id "gooo://origin-reader/elements/root_activity_id" type string required one
    field activity_id id "gooo://origin-reader/elements/activity_id" type string required one
    field completed id "gooo://origin-reader/elements/completed" type boolean required one
    field read_start id "gooo://origin-reader/elements/read_start" type integer required one
    field read_end id "gooo://origin-reader/elements/read_end" type integer required one
    field reads_dropped id "gooo://origin-reader/elements/reads_dropped" type integer required one
    field source_sha256 id "gooo://origin-reader/elements/source_sha256" type string required one
    field source_start id "gooo://origin-reader/elements/source_start" type integer required one
    field source_end id "gooo://origin-reader/elements/source_end" type integer required one
    field expression id "gooo://origin-reader/elements/expression" type string required one
    field mapping id "gooo://origin-reader/elements/mapping" type string required one
}
entity Explanation id "gooo://origin-reader/elements/explanation" fields {
    field category id "gooo://origin-reader/elements/category" type string required one
    field count id "gooo://origin-reader/elements/count" type integer required one
}
activity GoooPackage0ActivityExplain(Origin) -> Explanation computes "let count = input.read_end - input.read_start\nif !input.completed { return Explanation{category: \"INTERRUPTED\", count: count} }\nif input.mapping != \"MAPPED\" { return Explanation{category: \"SOURCE_UNMAPPED\", count: count} }\nif input.reads_dropped > 0 { return Explanation{category: \"READS_PARTIAL\", count: count} }\nif count == 0 { return Explanation{category: \"NO_READ_IN_WINDOW\", count: count} }\nif count == 1 { return Explanation{category: \"ONE_READ\", count: count} }\nreturn Explanation{category: \"MULTIPLE_READS\", count: count}"
